description:
T1 - Common Ash (Fraxinus excelsior). Approximately 10 meters in height. Previously reduced with well healed pruning wounds but over extended regrowth over footpath. Lower canopy in direct contact with a line of commercial buildings (workshops/storage etc).Proposal to reduce previously reduced East facing limb back to previous and crown lift over commercial buildings giving 2-3m clearance to prevent damage.
T2 - Common Oak (Quercus robur). Approximately 9 meters in height. Previously reduced with well healed pruning wounds but with overextended South Westerly facing limb causing access issues on adjacent access road. Proposal to crown lift over commercial buildings and
adjacent access road.
T3 - Sycamore (Acer pseudoplatanus). Approximately 11 meters in height. Lower canopy in direct contact with a line of commercial buildings workshops/storage etc). Proposal to crown lift over commercial buildings giving 2-3m clearance to prevent damage.
T4 - Walnut (Juglans regia). Approximately 7 meters in height. Stem is in close proximity to line of commercial buildings and lower canopy in direct contact. Proposal to crown lift over commercial buildings giving 2-3m clearance to prevent damage.
T5 - Japanese Maple (Acer Palmatum). Approximately 4 meters in height. In direct contact with both residential and commercial buildings. Proposal to cut back from building and crown lift giving 1-2m clearance to prevent damage.
All pruning cuts to be made back suitable growth points in accordance with BS3998.
